# 152. Maximum Product Subarray

## Solution 1 (O(n))

```python
# Dynamic programming
class Solution(object):
    def maxProduct(self, nums):
        """
        :type nums: List[int]
        :rtype: int
        """
        dp1 = [0] * len(nums)  # max
        dp2 = [0] * len(nums)  # min
        dp1[0] = dp2[0] = nums[0]
        for i in range(1, len(nums)):
            dp1[i] = max(dp1[i - 1] * nums[i], dp2[i - 1] * nums[i], nums[i])
            dp2[i] = min(dp1[i - 1] * nums[i], dp2[i - 1] * nums[i], nums[i])
        return max(dp1)
```
